summary: Nothing in the portfolio is broken on the evidence read today, and every survivor has a full review from the past seven days. Health rose from 80 to 88 because Rising climbed from 65 to 82 once its campaign load and 37 other findings closed, while Apothecary, Everything and Gnosis each held at 89 or better. Spend on the four survivors fell from 2,800 dollars to 596 in the week ending 2026-10-03. The one thing past due is Kane's: the desktop plugin upload missed its 2026-09-30 deadline, and its two queue rows are now 39 days old. Rising carries the only design question with a clock on it, the structure spawn loop, whose default executes 2026-10-16.

topActions.label: Upload plugin/personal-skills-0.7.0.zip in the desktop application and delete the seven duplicate skills, then run check-plugin-snapshot.ps1 expecting zero splits; the 2026-09-30 deadline has passed.
Call pull-safe.py from the Everything status-commit path and change the bare autostash pull advice in PortfolioOps check-unpushed.py to it.
Wire the per-structure spawn timer on the declared constants and play c03 headless; D-OPEN-50 executes that default on 2026-10-16.
Post the v1.3.2 dev-log entry with discord-notify.ps1 and confirm the dedupe file advances.
Rewrite the save-to-vault line in .project-context.json to record the 2026-09-26 cut.
Bound the worker list-then-get key-value loops below the per-invocation operation cap.
